disclaimer: Reference guidance only. Always verify ABO/Rh compatibility via blood bank cross-match before transfusion.

Whole Blood.label: Whole Blood
Whole Blood.clinicalNote: Standard red-cell and plasma unit matching recipient ABO/Rh rules. O- is the emergency universal red-cell donor; AB+ is the universal recipient.

PRBC.label: Packed Red Blood Cells (PRBC)
PRBC.clinicalNote: Contains concentrated red blood cells. Follows red-cell antigen rules: O- donates to all groups; AB+ receives from all 8 groups.

Platelets.label: Platelets (RDP / SDP)
Platelets.clinicalNote: ABO-compatible platelets are preferred first; Rh-negative female recipients under 50 should receive Rh-negative platelets (or anti-D prophylaxis) when possible.

Plasma.label: Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP)
Plasma.clinicalNote: Plasma compatibility reverses red-cell ABO rules because plasma carries antibodies instead of red-cell antigens. AB plasma is the universal donor; O patients can receive plasma from any group.
